source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (D:/Projects/echarts/dist/echarts.js) + zrender 6.1.0, node SSR (svg), controlled clock
note: D4: realtimeSort. A case sets `option` at T0 (its own flush; the init sort runs after it); then a frame every 20 ms: the inputs at t (setOption: a merge, flushing; action: dispatchAction), else NOW = T0 + t and zr.animation.update() -- whose stage is zr._flush(false), so `rendered` follows each stepped frame -- then the record. elements: bars by series and data index (shape, ignore, label text, animators), axis leaves by owner/anid; track[k][frame] where the value changes, final otherwise; present: the frames an element is there (null: all); finalText the last values as JavaScript prints them. events: every changeaxisorder event, at the frame it came in. sorts: each category axis model's categorySortInfo per frame.

cases.note: the gallery's race: the init sort at 0 (B D A E C), the top three shown; data at 100 overtakes as the bars grow -- several reorders in the middle of the 1000 ms tween, the bars sliding on the y axis' 300 ms, the clipped ones ignored; more data at 1300

vertical bars, the x axis category; the enter grows for 500 ms and the init sort lands on it (the counts restart a frame later); a reorder at every crossing of the 800 ms cubicOut update, the bars sliding on the x axis' 400 ms
the same on an inverse category x axis: the order runs right to left
ties: the sort is V8's stable sort, a tie keeps the data order; a tie is not a change (only `value > lastValue` is); an update to all equal values reorders nothing
two bar series on the category axis, only the first racing: the second moves with the axis order at ITS OWN update timing (a plain update), the racing one on the axis' timing
an update that keeps the order: the bars grow, no changeAxisOrder after the init sort
max 1: the two hidden bars swap -- the order changed, but not inside the extent: no dispatch (checked every frame); then one of them climbs into view
animation false: the bars are at their values at once, so the `rendered` of setOption's own flush finds the new order -- the reorder is dispatched inside setOption
six categories, five data: the sort info has five numbers, setSortInfo puts the unused category after them
two updates 120 ms apart: the counts go on from their interpolated values, the bars from where they are

no race: changeAxisOrder dispatched by hand on a category x axis -- the axis takes the order, the bars update on the series' timing, the labels transition; no setOption has given the counts a previous value, so each order's render counts them again from 0 at enter timing (200 ms); a second one at 600 names three ordinals

[milestone D1-D4] no race: a lazy merge adds a sixth row, and an init sort dispatched by hand in the same frame renders it -- the bar the init sort's render adds takes its layout at once (BarView: isInitSort -> attr), the five it updates likewise

[milestone D1-D4] the hand-dispatched orders of action-change-order, the second at 400 while the first one's counts (from 0, 200 ms) are still running: they count again from their interpolated values, not from 0
[milestone D1-D4] the update at 600 keeps A, B and D: their labels take the value as prevValue (no count), so the reorders after it do not count them again
[milestone D1-D4] clip: false on the racing series: it clips anyway (BarView: needsClip = clip || realtimeSort), the two bars past max ignored

[milestone D1-D4] race-partial-data with a bar of nought: the category with no bar is Number.MIN_VALUE, above the nought, so the order has moved; the tick past the rows is a difference in view, and every rendered frame dispatches the same order again
